sequence.purpose: bounded catch-up from the cursor when send() reopens a closed stream

notes: startIndex is the next stored line to read (the client's session.streamIndex).
Lease renewals (no idle close) reconnect as {startIndex: N} once a minute.

recordedWith.client: eve/react useEveAgent (pinned 1.5.0) in a Next 16.3.6 static export

auth: Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>` from `auth.bearer` (spike used `Bearer dev:<uid>`).
clientHeaders: Headers passed to `send(message, { headers })` are sent on that POST and then reused on the stream reads that follow it (eve: 'become the stream's credentials on its next reconnect'). The spike page sends `x-andronix-client-msg-id` (uuid per send) and `x-andronix-entry`; see docs/spike.md, contract note C1.
